chunk.content: Bandeng is the milkfish Chanos chanos (Fabricius, 1775), the only species in family Chanidae (order Gonorynchiformes); a marine, freshwater and brackish benthopelagic, amphidromous species of the Indo-West Pacific.
chunk.source_quote: Teleostei (teleosts) > Gonorynchiformes (Milkfishes) > Chanidae (Milkfish) ... Marine; freshwater; brackish; benthopelagic; amphidromous
